annotations.title: Score Bid/No-Bid Pwin & Match Capability Statement

description: Evaluate an RFP scope against a vendor's Capability Statement and past performance to compute a 0-100 Probability of Win (Pwin) score, a Gate-1 Bid/No-Bid recommendation, a technical/socioeconomic gap analysis, and a tailored executive pitch. This is a read-only, stateless capture scoring call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; both `rfp_text` and `company_capability_statement` are required, while `target_pursuit_role` weights eligibility rules for 'prime_contractor', 'subcontractor', or 'either_prime_or_sub' [default]). Use this tool at Gate-1 capture qualification to decide whether to bid an opportunity; use `generate_teaming_strategy` instead if you already decided to bid and need a 13 CFR 125.6 (50% Rule) Prime/Sub workshare plan, or `match_key_personnel` to evaluate individual candidate resumes.

company_capability_statement.description: Vendor capability statement including core competencies, socioeconomic certifications (8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone), facility clearances, and past performance summary.

rfp_text.description: Target solicitation scope, mandatory technical qualifications, NAICS/set-aside designation, clearance requirements, and Section M evaluation criteria.

target_pursuit_role.description: Intended pursuit role: 'prime_contractor' enforces strict set-aside and past-performance minimums, 'subcontractor' scores niche workshare fit, and 'either_prime_or_sub' (default) recommends the highest-Pwin path.

name: match_capability_statement

capability_gaps.description: Unmet RFP requirements or compliance blockers.

pwin_score.description: Calculated Probability of Win (Pwin) score from 0 to 100.

strengths_and_discriminators.description: Matched vendor capabilities and competitive discriminators.

tailored_executive_pitch.description: Ready-to-use executive summary pitch aligned to the buyer agency.
